merge_dictionaries: merge multiple dictionaries into one with later dictionaries taking precedence
merge_with_function: merge multiple dictionaries applying a function to combined values for duplicate keys
update_in_nested_dict: update a value in a potentially nested dictionary without mutating the original
get_in_nested_dict: get a value from a nested dictionary by a list of keys with optional default
groupby_collection: group a collection of items by a key function or attribute name
